signal.summary: 这项研究利用仿真或三维场景生成，为具身智能提供训练、测试和安全验证所需的可控环境。

editorial.intro: 这项研究利用仿真或三维场景生成，为具身智能提供训练、测试和安全验证所需的可控环境。
editorial.why_it_matters: 高质量仿真能够降低真实机器人试错成本，但关键在于生成环境是否保留了任务和物理约束。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对仿真与真实环境之间的差距，以及是否能复现到真实机器人。

evidence.title: Scale AV Perception Across Vehicle Platforms with NVIDIA Omniverse NuRec
evidence.excerpt: Robotics English 中文 Scale AV Perception Across Vehicle Platforms with NVIDIA Omniverse NuRec Aug 31, 2026 By Apurv Naman , Mingfei Guo , Dominik Froehlich and Wonsik Han Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary NVIDIA Omniverse NuRec reconstructs real-world driving scenes with 3D Gaussian splatting and renders new camera views for a target vehicle configuration. The Physical AI NuRec Dataset on Hugging Face provides over 1,500 neural-reconstructed scenes, each about 20 seconds long and captured from six camera views. Developers pair a reconstructed scene with a target rig, render the target views, refine frames with NVIDIA Harmonizer , and train a perception model on the output. An internal automated driving program measured relative gains in object-detection precision and recall after training on NuRec-rendered synthetic data for a new carline compared with a zero-shot baseline. The NVIDIA/nurec-skills repository packages the workflow as agent skills for downloading scenes, rendering with NuRec, and applying Harmonizer. Next Steps Download a USDZ scene and the included sample target rig from the Physical AI NuRec Dataset to begin adapting a reconstructed scene. Review the NuRec
